Service area

Rooted in Utah County.
Happy to explore.

Based in the Provo–Orem area, with sessions throughout Utah County and travel along the Wasatch Front by arrangement.

Provo, Orem & Utah County

From family portraits to graduations, missionary photos and proposals, we can plan a session close to home. Tell me if you have a setting in mind in Provo, Orem, Springville, Pleasant Grove, American Fork, or Lehi.

Salt Lake City and north toward Ogden

I’m open to traveling for sessions along this corridor, including Sandy, Draper, Salt Lake City, Bountiful, Layton, and potentially Ogden. Availability, travel costs, and location access are confirmed before booking.

A location that fits your session

Share your preferred city, date, and session type. We’ll discuss the light, season, walking distance, and any venue requirements before choosing a location.
